channel.title: BiteKrakow
channel.description: Independent guides to where locals eat and drink in Kraków: openings, neighborhood guides and cuisine rankings, every place visited in person.

item.title: Autumn Menus in Krakow 2026: Pumpkin Spice, Matcha, Hojicha
item.description: Autumn in Krakow: COPPA's pumpkin spice and hojicha, Yume matcha at Café Belmont, Bruk Cafe by the station, and restaurants cooking pumpkin and game.

item.description: Cafes and brunch in Kazimierz, Krakow: the best matcha and coffee at Café Belmont, cafes in former prayer houses and where to sit when plac Nowy overflows.

item.description: Art & Food Bazar at Stary Kleparz: free Sunday food fair on 18 Oct, 15 Nov and 6 Dec 2026, 11:00 to 17:00. What to expect and where to eat before and after.

item.title: Jesienne menu w Krakowie 2026: pumpkin spice, matcha, hojicha
item.description: Gdzie pić jesień w Krakowie: pumpkin spice i hojicha w COPPIE, matcha Yume w Café Belmont, Bruk Cafe przy dworcu i restauracje z dynią i dziczyzną w karcie.

item.title: Art & Food Bazar na Starym Kleparzu: terminy, godziny i jak zaplanować niedzielę
item.description: Art & Food Bazar na Starym Kleparzu: darmowy niedzielny festiwal jedzenia 18.10, 15.11 i 6.12.2026, 11:00 do 17:00. Co tam jest i gdzie zjeść przed i po.

item.title: Breakfast in Krakow: 6 Places That Actually Open Early (2026)
item.description: Where to eat breakfast in Krakow from 7:00: six independent spots with exact opening hours, prices and what to order, from Kleparz by the station to Kazimierz.

item.title: الماتشا في كراكوف: أين تشربها في كازيميَش
item.description: أين تشرب الماتشا في كراكوف. في كازيميَش، يحضّر Café Belmont ماتشا خاصة به تحت اسم Yume Matcha: درجة احتفالية، تحضير صحيح، ومشروبات مثلجة موسمية. العنوان والساعات والأسعار وماذا تطلب.

item.title: Matcha in Krakow: Where to Drink It in Kazimierz
item.description: Where to drink matcha in Krakow: three cafes that take it seriously. Cafe Belmont in Kazimierz whisks its own under the Yume Matcha brand, Ayko is a dedicated matcha bar in Podgorze, Boby in Debniki does coffee and matcha. Addresses, hours, prices. Updated September 2026.

item.title: Gdzie na matchę w Krakowie: 3 miejsca, które robią to dobrze
item.description: Gdzie napić się dobrej matchy w Krakowie: Café Belmont na Kazimierzu z własną matchą Yume, Ayko w Podgórzu i Boby na Dębnikach. Adresy, godziny, ceny i co zamówić.

item.title: Krakow Restaurant Week 2026: Dates, Prices, Rules and How to Book
item.description: Krakow Restaurant Week runs 7 Oct to 25 Nov 2026: three courses and a cocktail for 69.99 zl plus a 12.99 zl fee at 54 restaurants. Rules, cancellation, is it worth it.

item.title: Krakow Restaurant Week 2026: All 54 Restaurants by District and the 12 We Would Book
item.description: Krakow Restaurant Week 2026: all 54 restaurants sorted by district with festival dishes and prices, the 12 we would book first, and the booking questions answered.

item.title: Restaurant Week Kraków jesień 2026: lista 54 restauracji, ceny, rezerwacja i czy warto
item.description: Restaurant Week Kraków trwa do 25 listopada 2026. Lista 54 restauracji z daniami i cenami, realny koszt z opłatą 12,99 zł, zasady anulowania i które stoliki rezerwować.

item.title: Najlepsze bary koktajlowe w Krakowie: 6 miejsc wartych wieczoru
item.description: Gdzie na koktajle w Krakowie: bar z muzyką przy Plantach, dwa speakeasy za ukrytymi drzwiami, klasyka na Mikołajskiej, dziedziniec fortu na Kleparzu i drinki w dawnej bożnicy. Adresy, co zamówić, ceny.

item.title: Kleparz: gdzie zjeść i napić się kawy przy najstarszym targu Krakowa
item.description: Przewodnik po Kleparzu w Krakowie: Stary Kleparz z ośmiusetletnią tradycją, kawa specialty pięć minut od dworca, cukiernia z pierwszą czekoladą dubajską w mieście i co zobaczyć po drodze.

item.title: Kawa specialty w Krakowie: jedna kawiarnia na dzielnicę
item.description: Gdzie na kawę specialty w Krakowie, dzielnica po dzielnicy: Kleparz, Kazimierz, Krowodrza, Wesoła i korytarz Starowiślnej. Jeden sprawdzony adres na dzielnicę, z cenami i tym, co zamówić.

item.title: 8 New Restaurants and Cafes in Krakow, Autumn 2026
item.description: What opened in Krakow this autumn: a Zablocie steakhouse, empanadas on Krupnicza, a gluten-free bakery, a coffee roastery and a 30 zl milk bar. Addresses.

item.title: Best Cocktail Bars in Krakow: 6 Rooms Worth Dressing For
item.description: Where to drink cocktails in Krakow: a marquee cocktail-and-music bar off the Planty, two proper speakeasies behind hidden doors, a classic Old Town mixology room, a Kleparz courtyard with live music, and cocktails in a former synagogue. Addresses, what to order, prices. Updated September 2026.

item.title: Best Wine Bars in Krakow: 6 Rooms for Polish and Natural Wine
item.description: Where to drink wine in Krakow: Polish bottles at the Kleparz market, natural and low-intervention wine in Zablocie and Kazimierz, a Michelin-recommended tapas and wine spot in Podgorze, and Georgian wine by the glass. Addresses, what to order, prices. Updated September 2026.

item.title: Best Brunch in Krakow: 6 Spots for a Slow Weekend Late Morning
item.description: Where to go for a proper sit-down brunch in Krakow, not a rushed early breakfast: buffets and crepes in Kazimierz, eggs benedict in Krowodrza, a French bakery on the Old Town edge, vegan plates and a riverside cafe with a view. Addresses, what to order, prices. Updated August 2026.

item.title: The 10 Best Restaurants in Krakow (2026): A Local's Ranking
item.description: A local's ranking of the best restaurants in Krakow across every cuisine: the two-Michelin-star Polish table, the best pizza, sushi, Georgian, Vietnamese, Thai, Indian and kebab in the city. Real addresses, prices and what to order.

item.title: Cheap Eats in Krakow (2026): Where to Eat Well Under 30 Zloty
item.description: A local's guide to cheap eats in Krakow: milk bars, hand-folded pierogi, the best kebab in town, halal Indian from 16 zloty and banh mi under 25. Real addresses and exactly what to order on a budget.

item.title: Krakow Christmas Market 2026: What to Eat and Drink
item.description: A local's guide to eating at the Krakow Christmas Market on the Main Square, winter 2026: dates and hours, and exactly what to eat and drink, from grzaniec mulled wine and grilled oscypek to sausage, pierogi and pączki. With halal and vegetarian tips.

item.title: Best Georgian Restaurants in Krakow (2026): Khachapuri, Khinkali and Wine
item.description: A local's guide to the best Georgian food in Krakow: the boat-shaped khachapuri, soup dumplings by the river, a home-style kitchen and the only place making its own Georgian cheese. Real addresses, prices and what to order first.

item.title: Best Indian Restaurants in Krakow (2026): Curry, Tandoor, Dosa and Vegan
item.description: A local's guide to the best Indian food in Krakow: the city's highest-rated North Indian, the only real South Indian dosa kitchen, the best butter chicken, and a fully vegan sattvic room. Real addresses, prices and what to order.

item.title: Best Italian Restaurants in Krakow (2026): Pizza, Pasta and Where Locals Go
item.description: A local's guide to the best Italian food in Krakow: the Neapolitan pizza that started the wave, truffle pasta on the prettiest street, and the fine-dining seafood room off the Main Square. Real addresses, prices and what to order.

item.title: Best Kebab and Middle Eastern Food in Krakow (2026): The Places Locals Argue About
item.description: A local's guide to the best kebab and Middle Eastern food in Krakow: the Syrian charcoal grill locals call the best kebab in town, a 4.8-star doner with 2,300 reviews, tandoor-baked flatbread, hummus 25 ways and Israeli mezze. Real addresses and prices.

item.title: Best Korean Food in Krakow (2026): Bibimbap, Fried Chicken and K-Hot Pot
item.description: A local's guide to the best Korean food in Krakow: the Michelin-listed Korean-Japanese kitchen, a Seoul cafe's Krakow outpost, chef Park's bibimbap institution, the city's highest-rated kimbap and Korean fried chicken. Real addresses and prices.

item.title: Best Mexican Food in Krakow (2026): Real Tacos, Birria and Margaritas
item.description: A local's guide to the best Mexican food in Krakow: a Yucatán family taqueria, birria worth crossing the river for, a native-Mexican market stall with house-made tortillas, and the city's biggest tequila bar. Real addresses, prices and what to order.

item.title: Best Pierogi in Krakow (2026): Where Poles Actually Eat Polish Food
item.description: A local's guide to the best pierogi and Polish food in Krakow: an 80-year-old lunch canteen, a real milk bar on the Royal Route, hand-folded dumplings in open view, and Poland's only two-Michelin-star kitchen. Real addresses, prices and what to order.
